terms.description: At the moment of reservation, you must pay a deposit of 50% of the total amount of the reservation via credit card. The remaining amount has to be paid directly to the accommodation during your stay.

policies.description:
If you have to cancel for any reason, we will keep the deposit and if the places you cancelled are booked by someone else, you can use the deposit you paid for up to one year.
For a last-minute cancellation (5 days or less), a NO SHOW or an earlier departure, we will charge 100%.
